board: STM32H7B3I-DK (STM32H7B3LIH6Q, CPU 280 MHz, AXI 140 MHz, direct SMPS), powered from the laptop's USB port (ST-LINK CN14) through the meter; LCD, SDRAM, Octo-SPI flash and Wi-Fi module not initialised by the firmware
firmware: firmware/stm32h7b3i_dk, app energy (common/Src/main_energy.c), model unas_h7_c140_seed42_body_int8qdq.onnx generated with -O time
meter: Joy-IT JT-UM120 USB tester, between the laptop's USB port and the board; display resolution 1 mV, 1 mA, 1 mW as read
regulator: board 3.3 V regulator not documented in UM2569 (MCU current jumper JP2), so no MCU-side energy is derived
read_by: the experimenter, from the meter's display, 2026-10-16 at about 16:00
phase_times: from paper/results/board/energy/STM32H7B3I-DK__unas_h7_c140_Otime_serial.log (laptop clock): loop 15:47:23-15:54:27, STOP 15:54:28-15:55:02, loop from 15:55:03
